title: Climbing Mod
description: Mod that recreates mechanics from "Climbing Game".
body:
## Climbing Mod

This mod is an attempt to recreate mechanics from Roblox's game "[Climbing Game](https://www.roblox.com/games/119689727784858)" by TheBigC10. Check it out too!

The Climbing Game's mechanics are inspired by "[Peaks Of Yore](https://store.steampowered.com/app/2236070/Peaks_of_Yore/)", so you might find it similar to that game.
## 
![Every hold on one wall](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/09df1f2bd134ea6a31269540cf349a1e49d2f966.png)
## The holds.

> **Stone button - Hold.** A normal hold, doesn't drain stamina, recovers stamina while hanging on it.
>
> **Crimson button - Grip.** Same thing as normal hold, but to grab it you need to press jump on it.
>
> **Polished blackstone button - Crumble.** A crumbling hold, which breaks after 3 seconds after you grab it.
>
> **Warped button - Crimp.** Acts like a normal hold, except it drains stamina while you hang on it.
>
> **Bamboo button - Release.** Basically a Crimp, but drains stamina way faster.
>
> **Packed ice in Item frame - Slippery.** This is a wall that you can grab on, and while you hanging, it slides you to the bottom.
>
> **Red sandstone in Item frame - Kick.** Same as slippery, but it doesn't slide you to the bottom, and also gives you extra horizontal boost.

## Compatibility

This mod is **not compatible** with **mods that move blocks** in any form; will be unplayable on servers that have anti-cheat.

## Troubleshooting

If you switch between mod versions and something broke or doesn't work - **delete config file**. Most of the times it solves your problems.
